title: Horizon Topology Changes and Stable Higher-Dimensional Black Holes
exact_target: Are there other mechanisms for horizon topology changes, and are all stable higher-dimensional black holes moderately rotating Myers--Perry solutions?

status_qualification: Both questions are retained as source conjectural speculation. The supplied $J/M^{D-3}$ is not replaced by a guessed dimensionless normalization; conventional dimensionless spin uses dimension-dependent powers. The asymptotic and rotation hypotheses need source clarification.
